final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, c.State AS state_province, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State), step2 AS (SELECT state_province, SUM(record_count) AS state_count FROM step1 WHERE state_province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state_province), step3 AS (SELECT s1.invoice_id, s1.state_province, s1.record_count, 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.state_count AS quotient FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON CAST(s1.state_province AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(s2.state_province AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT state_province, AVG(quotient) AS avg_quotient FROM step3 GROUP BY state_province) SELECT s3.invoice_id, s3.state_province, s3.record_count, s3.quotient, s3.quotient - s4.avg_quotient AS quotient_minus_average FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON CAST(s3.state_province AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(s4.state_province AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY WHERE s3.quotient > s4.avg_quotient ORDER BY quotient_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
